forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {被|こうむ}っていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to suffer, to sustain, to incur
definitions.explanation: To receive or sustain damage, loss, harm, or other negative consequences. A formal word typically used in written or official contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{被|こうむ}った。
⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{甚大|じんだい}→甚大：17386_jindai⟧な⟦{損害|そんがい}→損害：02615_songai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{被|こうむ}った。
examples.english: We suffered enormous losses from the typhoon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{不正|ふせい}→不正：01660_fusei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{信用|しんよう}→信用：03267_shinyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{失墜|しっつい}→失墜：21432_shittsui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{被|こうむ}ることになった。
examples.english: The company ended up suffering a loss of credibility due to fraud.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal, somewhat literary verb. More common in news, legal texts, and official reports than in everyday conversation. The object is always something negative: damage, loss, harm, inconvenience.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive (more general, can be positive or negative)
- {食|く}らう: to suffer, to be hit with (informal/colloquial)

NOTE ON KANJI:
The kanji {被|こうむ}る is the same as in {被|かぶ}る (to wear on the head), but the reading こうむる has a completely different meaning.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{被|こうむ}る: to sustain damage
- ⟦{損害|そんがい}→損害：02615_songai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{被|こうむ}る: to incur losses
- ⟦{損失|そんしつ}→損失：04875_sonshitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{被|こうむ}る: to suffer a loss
- ⟦{迷惑|めいわく}→迷惑：02432_meiwaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{被|こうむ}る: to suffer inconvenience
- ⟦{不利益|ふりえき}→不利益：11481_furieki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{被|こうむ}る: to suffer a disadvantage
